name: Sopronhorpács (Hungary)
description: A vertical medium blue banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Sopronhorpács: a quartered blue and red shield with a church, a gateway, a bunch of grapes and a horse, inscribed SOPRONHORPÁCS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
